title: Remove backend DB columns
description: Removes columns (or relations) from a Drizzle table, then syncs the contract, the service and their specs.

name.description: The table, by resource name, singular or plural (e.g. orders).

columns.description: Columns or relations to remove (e.g. name, customer, customerId, tags). `dafne remove backend-db-column` asks for them.

migration.description: The migration is generated right after (dafne remove backend-db-column does it): leave it out of the next steps.
